where
  call = API::moduleImport("ctypes").getMember("windll").getMember("kernel32").getMember(_).getACall() or

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess with shell=True
 * @description Calling subprocess with shell=True can be dangerous.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-true
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

predicate isTrue(Expr e) {
  e.(NameConstant).getId() = "True"
  or
  e.(Name).getId() = "True"
}

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() and
  exists(Keyword k |
    k = call.asExpr().(Call).getAKeyword() and
    k.getArg() = "shell" and
    isTrue(k.getValue())
  )
select call, "Subprocess call with shell=True."
findings.hypothesis: Subprocess calls with shell=True are vulnerable to command injection.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Identify Windows API calls
 * @description Lists the specific Windows API functions called via ctypes.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity recommendation
 * @id py/win-api-calls
 * @tags audit
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string funcName
where
   exists(API::Node kernel32 |
     kernel32 = API::moduleImport("ctypes").getMember("windll").getMember("kernel32")
     and
     call = kernel32.getMember(funcName).getACall()
   )
select call, "Calls Windows API function: " + funcName
